text: No, the whole property was not cleared in 2021. Only about 2.23% (81.3 hectares) of the 3,643.5-hectare rural property experienced tree-cover loss that year. This loss was primarily within planted forests (68.1 hectares of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with minimal impact on native forests (0 hectares). The change was detected as stand-replacement events, which could include harvesting rather than full clearing. Smaller patches (37.3 hectares) under 0.5 hectares were excluded from this total. The evidence does not confirm deforestation, legality, or land-use change.
